agent_settings._note: Times are local to the Pi (set the Pi to Asia/Kolkata). Kite access tokens expire around 06:00 IST, so analysis_time must be before midnight for the token issued at login_time to still be valid.

llm._note: repeat_penalty must stay near 1.0. The previous value of 1.3 penalised the model for re-emitting the required 'SCORE:'/'REASON:' literals, which is a large part of why every stock came back unscored.

narrative._note: LLM prose is validated against the computed fact sheet. Any ticker or figure not present in the source data causes a retry, then a fall back to a deterministic template.

web._note: Read-only report browser (pfm/web.py). Its own process and port, entirely separate from the Node home-dashboard app. Bind to 0.0.0.0 so it is reachable over the LAN and VPN; do not expose it to the public internet.

portfolio._note: usd_inr_rate converts the US book into the combined rupee total. Leave null and the US book is reported in dollars only rather than converted at an assumed rate.

indmoney._note: Read-only MCP server for the US book. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, handled by mcp-remote; sign in once with 'python tools/probe_indmoney.py --list-only' and the token is cached under ~/.mcp-auth. Set enabled to false, or pass --no-us, to report Indian holdings only.

tracking._note: News is scored for every symbol actually held in Kite, plus the watchlist below. Held symbols with no explicit keywords fall back to matching the symbol itself, so newly bought stocks are picked up automatically.

exclude_phrases._note: Phrases removed from the article text before keyword matching, so sibling listed companies are not mis-attributed - e.g. an SBI Cards story must not count as SBIN news.
